title: B4.2: the values a question offers the person travel as a list, never guessed from its words
request: The owner chose, after B4.1's six review rounds on guessing choices from a question's words: the agent lists the values it offers in a separate field, so nothing has to be guessed.
spec: the team workspace plan (more room for AI, compared three ways), B3-B4; B4.1's dev record (R19-R25, risks)
plan: team_clarify gets options (2-6 short lines); code writes them under the question in one fixed form and reads them back exactly
agent arm: the question's own words are all premise; each option checked as a value to pick
scorer: listed options read exactly, words premise; questions with no options keep the old word rule
prompt: values to pick go in options

decisions.decision: options are rendered into the delivered text by code, in one fixed form, instead of a new delivery column
decisions.why: no store migration and no change to the relays through Business and the Lead: the text travels whole and read_choices gives back the exact list; a text not in the exact form is all premise

decisions.decision: an option may carry an off-record number only when it is a value to pick: never a count of the data, never a measured result, never under a question that checks a fact
decisions.why: the same 'when unsure, premise' rule as B4.1: a false premise sends the question back, a false choice lets an invented number through; 'top 500 accounts' becomes premise by design

decisions.decision: questions with no listed options (rules arm, helper arm, every earlier play) are still read by split_choices
decisions.why: the comparison with round 0 stays like for like; the agent arm can no longer rely on it, since its question words are all premise

change: teamspace tools (options, render_choices, read_choices, options_problem, relay read-back), agent_arm (check_option, option_free, tagged texts), team_arms score (question_parts, option_free, gate re-pinned), prompt team_agent, tests

findings.defect: an option stating a count of the data or a measured result passed as a choice
findings.scenario: options 'Drop them: 812 rows have no date', 'Use the sample (it has 8 columns)', 'Holdout AUC: 0.81'
findings.cause: option_free checked fact and measure words only next to a value, and never counts
findings.fix: an option with a count, or a non-time value and a measure word anywhere, is premise (both copies)

findings.defect: a question sentence written again as an option got the looser option check
findings.scenario: question 'We could score at 45 days before renewal. Which window?' with that sentence also as an option
findings.cause: texts were told apart by matching words
findings.fix: texts tagged by where they came from

findings.defect: Business's rules could not relay a question with options
findings.scenario: Data Science asks with options; Business's rules ask the person the delivered text; the choices line was refused
findings.cause: a question holding the choices head was always refused
findings.fix: a question holding a code-written choices line and no options is read back into question and options

findings.defect: no end-to-end scorer test for an off-record count in an option
findings.scenario: a rendered question with option 'Drop them: 812 rows have no date'
findings.fix: test added: it is a hard zero

measurements.name: round-0 dev plays rescored read-only
limits: no play in round 0 used options

measurements.name: make agent-eval and make harness-eval after the prompt change

outcome: built, reviewed (2 findings fixed), tests pass on files and PostgreSQL (417 tests); no live run yet
lessons: when a text rule guards a guarantee and keeps failing review, change the interface so the model states its intent in a field code can read exactly
tag texts by their source, never by matching their words
risks: an option's 'value to pick' test is still a word rule; it errs toward premise
a model may still write choices in its question text; it is refused and told to use options, which costs a rewrite step
